subject.title: fix(browser): finalize assistant turns on positive completion proof (stop preamble/mid-stream capture)

question: After the live-region activity-veto defect is repaired, must the repaired exact head complete a real long-Pro browser run before merge, or should the earlier-head proof plus regression suite be accepted?
rationale: The owner explicitly imposed an exact-head live-proof hold, while the inability to complete that run is caused by a separate prompt-submission defect; only maintainer intent can waive this repository-specific gate.

options.title: Require exact-head live proof
options.body: Use the prompt-send fix, run the repaired exact head through a complete long-Pro response, and inspect redacted output before merge.

options.title: Waive exact-head proof
options.body: Accept the earlier live runs plus focused post-repair tests and record an explicit proof waiver.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head live proof
recommendation.body: Use the prompt-send fix, run the repaired exact head through a complete long-Pro response, and inspect redacted output before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the final hardening series and explicitly established the current proof hold.
